harness: ../exl3-reference/measure.py (kernels and synthetic modes, unchanged) via timing_session.sh; timing_stats.py; timing_protocol.py
interpretation: Reference-only timing controls for the P0 performance protocol. A/A sessions time upstream EXL3-G against itself on one frozen plan; the gemv session times EXL3-G (candidate) against EXL3-O (reference).

tuning_cache_bytes.note: base64 of every tuning cache the sessions used, keyed by SHA-256; the frozen EXL3-G caches are the same in every session

condensed_from: timing_stats.py output per session (per-case kernel symbol lists and bootstrap intervals dropped); the rule's evaluation by timing_protocol.py

sessions_stopped.h3: started under 13.1.1 with rule c35d9acf; stopped when the cuBLAS 13.8.0.4 recalibration superseded it, never evaluated

rule.note: timing_protocol.py at c05fd2dd..., fixed before c1-h6 and c5-h8 ran. BP-F2's reference is the NVCC 13.4.92 build: calibration c5-c8 (timing-calibration.json), holdout h7+h8. The earlier validation on the NVCC 13.0.88 build (calibration c1-c4, holdout h5+h6) is kept as calibration_nvcc130 and holdout_nvcc130.

format: sessions.*.cases are rows in the order of sessions.*.columns; timing_from_json.py rebuilds the summaries timing_protocol.py reads. Earlier sessions' per-case allowances under superseded rules are dropped; their summaries keep the pass counts.
